actions.name: access_actions
actions.description: Retrieve the list of available actions or the full definition of a specific action from actions.json.

params.action_name: string (optional) - name of the action to retrieve; if omitted, return a list of all action names
params.include_internal: boolean (optional) - include internal/hidden actions when listing (default: false)

actions.name: read_file
actions.description: Read the content of a file.

actions.name: write_file
actions.description: Write content to a file (overwrites existing content).

actions.name: update_actions_json
actions.description: Create a new action or update an existing one in core_argos_actions in actions.json.

params.action_definition: object - full JSON definition of the action

actions.name: create_action
actions.description: Create or update an action by adding it to auto_updated_actions in actions.json, writing the function to autoupdated_controller.py, and restarting the system.

params.action_definition: object - full JSON definition of the action including name, description, params, exec_type, and exec_code

actions.name: get_argos_root
actions.description: Get the root A.R.G.O.S folder path.

actions.name: request_file
actions.description: Request file content from user/program if missing.

params.reason: string - why the file is needed

actions.name: get_file_tree
actions.description: Return the file structure of the A.R.G.O.S folder in JSON format.

params.include_hidden: boolean (optional) - include hidden files and folders (default: false)

actions.name: find_file
actions.description: Search for files in the A.R.G.O.S root folder by name or pattern.

params.filename: string - name or pattern of the file to search
params.recursive: boolean (optional) - search recursively in subdirectories (default: true)

actions.name: execute_cmd
actions.description: Execute a command in CMD at the project root directory and return the output.

params.command: string - the command to execute in CMD

actions.name: fetch_webpage
actions.description: Fetch a webpage via HTTP GET, return raw HTML or parsed text. Uses requests and BeautifulSoup.

params.parse: boolean (optional) - whether to parse with BeautifulSoup and return text (default: false)
params.user_agent: string (optional) - custom User-Agent header (default: Mozilla/5.0 compatible)
